fields.label: Incoming Types
fields.options:
Types of Income

1. Salaries, wages, etc. Section 40(1)
2. Fees, commissions, etc. Section 40(2)
3. Royalties, etc. Section 40(3)
4. Interest, etc. Section 40(4)(a)
4.1.1 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(1.1): Net profits subject to 30% corporate income tax
4.1.2 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(1.2): Net profits subject to 25% corporate income tax
4.1.3 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(1.3): Net profits subject to 20% corporate income tax
4.1.4 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(1.4): Net profits subject to another corporate income tax rate (specify)
4.2.1 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(2.1): Net profits exempt from corporate income tax
4.2.2 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(2.2): Income exempt from inclusion in taxable income
4.2.3 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(2.3): Net profits offset by losses carried forward for up to 5 years
4.2.4 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(2.4): Profits recognized under the equity method
4.2.5 Dividends, profit shares, etc. Section 40(4)(b)(2.5): Other (specify)
5. Contract work, services, rent, transportation, etc. Section 3 tredecim
6. Other (specify)
